messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-7782 fired: p95 request latency > 1.2s for model-serve-prod-eu (10m window). Auto-escalation: page to oncall-rotation.

oncall-rotation: Ack PD-7782. Routing to sanjay (oncall).

sanjay: Ack. I'm taking this. Quick summary: gradual p95 creep over ~20m, concentrated in eu-west. No deploys in last 40m. Starting triage.

liz: Any infra changes or scale events?

sanjay: Autoscaler scaled down ~12m ago and didn't spin up fast enough under the sudden load pattern. kvcache miss rate jumped.

--- metrics snippet ---
```
kvcache_miss_rate: 0.27 -> 0.58
svc_p95: 0.9s -> 1.35s
queued_requests: 120 -> 450
error_rate(5xx): 0.1% -> 0.9%
```

aisha: On it, will raise min replicas in EU to buy headroom. Patching HPA now.

oncall-rotation: Post the command you run so we have an audit.

aisha: Ran: ```kubectl -n prod patch hpa model-serve-prod --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'```

tom: Can we route a portion of traffic to the quantized fallback model to reduce GPU latency while we stabilize?

sanjay: Good idea. We'll route 30% of non-sensitive traffic to quant-v2 (lower-cost quantized variant). Pushing routing change now.

Routing command (ops proxy):
```
echo '{"route":"model=quant-v2","traffic":0.3,"match":"!sensitive"}' | curl -s -XPOST https://ops.internal/routing/apply -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

liz: Customer impact check: telemetry shows ~2% of requests hitting client-observed timeouts for the 10m window, mostly free-tier and background embedding jobs. No inbound support tickets yet. Status page draft queued.

sanjay: Starting KV cache warmup script to prime frequent keys. Hitting warm endpoints at low qps.

aisha: Warmup in progress, kvcache miss rate falling in streaming metrics. Autoscaler already started adding pods; new pods registering.

incident-bot: PD-7782 acknowledged by sanjay.

oncall-rotation: Quick runbook checklist: 1) increase min replicas (done). 2) enable fallback routing (done). 3) warm KV cache (in progress). 4) monitor p95/p99 and queued_requests. 5) notify support if customer-facing errors >5%.

sanjay: Observing early improvement: svc_p95 -> 1.05s, queued_requests -> 220, kvcache_miss -> 0.33. Continuing to watch.

15m check-in:
aisha: Autoscaler steady at 6 replicas, new pods healthy. KV warmup complete.

liz: Status update posted: "We are investigating increased request latency in EU. Some traffic routed to a fallback model; no broad customer impact reported yet."

sanjay: Confirming p95 stabilized around 0.95s and p99 trending down. Error rate back to ~0.2%. Plan to let this run for 10 more minutes then start PD close sequence if stable.

oncall-rotation: Agreed. Keep channel updates every 5m. If stable at close window, I'll close the PD.

final: incident-bot: PD-7782: status -> resolved (closed by oncall-rotation).

oncall-rotation: PD closed. Post-incident actions: 1) adjust autoscaler sensitivity for eu cluster to avoid scale-down thrash, 2) add a short warmup step to post-scale events, 3) write a short postmortem note linking telemetry / runbook changes. Assign to eng-runtime to own follow-ups.

sanjay: Adding notes to the incident doc and creating follow-up tasks.

end of thread.
